angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 431,334 km at 75.32 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 13.2775 +/- 0.0123 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 75.32 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.62 +/- 0.019 solar radii from Morello et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2133 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag183M/abstract): 431,334 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.644 +/- 0.019 solar masses from Morello et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2133 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag183M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4250 +/- 45 K from Morello et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2133 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag183M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Morello et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2133 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag183M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2133.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.662, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2133: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2133 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.01 dex, from Morello et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.549ag183M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2133 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.85248, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1333818968701222272, flags_flame 00: age_flame 1.408341 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.2 to 5.9947004)
